summary.intent: Verify staging is operational by running a load test, then commit infrastructure changes (Prometheus scrape config and someguy healthcheck fix) to a new branch.
summary.outcome: Staging confirmed operational — 4/5 clients completed ~70 ops successfully; C4 had a transient vault init failure. Both docker infra changes were committed to a new chore branch.

repo: Load test lives at tests/e2e/tests/load-test.spec.ts and uses playwright.load.config.ts, targeting the staging environment with 5 concurrent clients doing ~70 ops each.
The load test has a 10-minute global timeout; full wallet auth + SIWE + Core Kit flows plus many IPNS publishes push close to that limit.
Alloy observability config is at docker/alloy-config.river; docker compose staging config at docker/docker-compose.staging.yml.
The fix/someguy-max-memory-bytes PR was expected to include the wget→curl healthcheck change but main still had wget, requiring the change to be committed separately.

code.finding: someguy healthcheck switched from wget to curl
Added Prometheus scrape target for someguy delegated routing sidecar

workflow: Load test artifacts (c4-* files, .last-run.json) are written to the working directory and must be excluded from commits.
A non-zero exit code from the load test does not necessarily mean staging is broken — timeout-induced exit code 1 is expected when the run is cut off while straggler clients are still logging.

friction: C4 client experienced complete vault initialization failure (every op timed out), requiring manual interpretation to distinguish transient issue from systemic failure.
10-minute timeout was too tight — test was cut off before C4 finished logging and before cleanup ran, leaving partial output.
Assumption that main already contained the wget→curl fix (from fix/someguy-max-memory-bytes PR) required an extra verification step before committing.
open_items: C4 transient vault initialization failure should be investigated — unclear why initial vault sync never completed for that client.
Load test timeout may need to be increased to accommodate full 5-client runs including cleanup.
Verify whether fix/someguy-max-memory-bytes PR actually landed the wget→curl change or if that was mistakenly assumed.
